tracks.label: Choose your track
tracks.title: Two outdoor circuits in Pattaya
tracks.lead: Whether you want ocean-side adrenaline by Walking Street or a technical challenge on Thepprasit Road — both locations run daily into the early morning.
bali.title: Bali Hai Pier
bali.body: High-speed racing by the ocean, steps from Bali Hai Pier and Walking Street. Two distinct tracks for tourists, families, groups and adrenaline lovers — plus panoramic terrace, night lighting, pool table and foosball.
thep.title: Thepprasit Road
thep.body: The newest racing circuit on Thepprasit Road — built for competitive lap times, precise corners and a more technical drive. Same kart lineup, lounge atmosphere and professional timing.
why.label: Why EasyKart Pattaya
why.title: Safe, timed, built for every level
why.lead: Professional timing systems, modern karts and high-performance machines — one of the top things to do in Pattaya for families, groups and adrenaline lovers.
why.1b: Near Walking Street — fun and accessible for tourists, families and groups.
why.2b: Newest circuit for precision, competitive laps and a greater driving challenge.
why.3b: Real-time digital lap times — compare performance instantly on screen.
why.4b: From kids and families to experienced drivers — karts and formats for every level.
karts.label: Go-kart models
karts.title: Pick your machine
karts.lead: Published package prices from EasyKart. Race = 8 minutes. 3+ races include a free collector T-shirt (while stocks last). Sport shoes mandatory; rentals 50 THB.
kart.kid.p: Safe introduction to racing — low-speed tuning and easy handling on the dedicated kid-friendly circuit.
kart.reg.p: Perfect for adult beginners and teens — comfortable handling and total control for a stress-free first race.
kart.fast.p: Built for thrill-seekers — sharp handling and instant acceleration on the long outdoor circuit.
kart.two.p: Share the speed with your kid or partner — dual steering wheels; the adult controls the pace.
karts.flex: Book online for faster arrival check-in, or walk in at the counter. Races start every 10 minutes — use tickets anytime during opening hours.

faq.label: Racing FAQ
faq.title: Everything before you race
faq.lead: Key answers from EasyKart Thailand’s FAQ — prices, bookings, kids, safety and formats. Full FAQ lives on easykart.net.
faq.q1: Do I need to book in advance?
faq.a1: At EasyKart Pattaya (Bali Hai Pier and Thepprasit) you can walk in during opening hours. Online booking gives faster check-in. Races start every 10 minutes with open-time tickets.
faq.a2: Each race lasts 8 minutes — about 10 to 15 laps depending on your speed. Multi-race packages are available for a longer session.
faq.a3: Kid Kart from 499 THB (1 race). Regular and 2-Seater from 699 THB (1 race). Fast Kart package from 1,499 THB (2 races). Confirm current packages on the booking page.
faq.a4: Sport / closed-toe shoes are mandatory. Shoe rental is 50 THB per pair (all sizes, includes new socks). Helmets included; racing suits free if you want the full look.
faq.a5: Both Pattaya tracks: daily 10:00 – 01:00 (after midnight). Outdoor locations with panoramic viewing areas.
faq.a6: EasyKart operates since 2004 across Thailand: Bangkok (RCA Plaza), Pattaya Bali Hai Pier, Pattaya Thepprasit, and Koh Samui (Chaweng Lake).
